validation.reason: Schema loads. Missing required operator runtime_image values refuse before planning; a supplied immutable fixture reaches the production renderer. Offline checks do not qualify image bytes or workloads.

task_fidelity.reason: The former fixed-image RTX evidence is bound to the prior workflow digest. The current operator-selected runtime image needs fresh workload qualification.

output_storage.reason: The selected project and run-scoped storage must pass current submission preflight.

worker_input.reason: Current scene inputs and applicable access terms must be checked for the selected operator image and run.

credentials.reason: Current storage and runtime credentials must pass preflight.

source_image.reason: Select an independently qualified immutable operator image; no public default is accepted.

target_runtime.reason: The selected exact image must complete the advertised native OptiX workload on the selected RTX target.
